REFERRING PHYSICIAN
Dr. [redacted name]
[redacted location] Children's Hospital
Department of Audiology

CLINICAL INFORMATION
Reason for Referral: Genetic testing for connexin-26 related hearing loss
Clinical Details: Pediatric patient presenting for evaluation of suspected hereditary hearing loss. Parental DNA samples are currently stored in our laboratory.

TEST REQUESTED
Connexin-26 (GJB2) Gene Analysis

METHODOLOGY
Bi-directional Sanger sequencing of the entire coding region and splice sites of the GJB2 gene (NM_004004.6)

RESULTS
TEST NOT PERFORMED

The DNA extraction from the submitted EDTA blood sample yielded insufficient quantity and quality of genomic DNA for reliable analysis. Multiple extraction attempts were performed using standard protocols, however, the DNA concentration remained below the minimum threshold required for Connexin-26 sequencing analysis (minimum requirement: 50 ng/μL, concentration >260/280 ratio of 1.8-2.0).

CLINICAL INTERPRETATION
Genetic assessment for connexin-26 related hearing loss could not be completed due to technical limitations with the submitted sample. No conclusions regarding the patient's GJB2 mutation status can be drawn at this time.

RECOMMENDATIONS
1. Repeat blood collection is requested for completion of genetic testing
   - Required volume: 1-3 mL whole blood in EDTA (purple top) tube
   - Please ensure proper mixing and prompt transport to laboratory
   
2. Alternative sample types that may be considered:
   - Buccal swab (if blood draw is challenging)
   - Saliva collection kit (available upon request)

3. Parental samples remain stored in our laboratory and are available for segregation analysis once patient testing is completed

NOTE: Mutations in the GJB2 gene account for up to 50% of cases of non-syndromic autosomal recessive hearing loss. Early genetic diagnosis can inform medical management, genetic counseling, and family planning decisions.

Please contact the laboratory at [redacted phone] with any questions regarding sample requirements or to arrange for repeat specimen collection.
